name: eMACS J2124.6-0133 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J2124.6-0133, a massive, X-ray-bright galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj212460133-hubble
story: A crowd of galaxies bound together into one of the extreme, X-ray-bright clusters found by the extended Massive Cluster Survey. Hubble caught it in a quick snapshot survey of such clusters.

claims.text: eMACS J2124.6-0133 is a target of Hubble program 16670, a snapshot survey of extreme galaxy clusters
The program targets massive, highly X-ray luminous galaxy clusters
eMACS is the extended Massive Cluster Survey, which finds highly X-ray luminous galaxy clusters
